cases.problem_statement: In a nondegenerate Euclidean triangle $ABC$, prove that its interior angles sum to $180^\circ$.
cases.body_source: Draw through $A$ a line parallel to $BC$. Alternate interior angles identify the two angles beside angle $A$ with angles $B$ and $C$. These three angles form a straight angle, hence sum to $180^\circ$.

cases.problem_statement: In triangle $ABC$, suppose $AB=AC$. Prove $\angle ABC=\angle BCA$.

cases.candidate_reason: Candidate valid proof; requires independent coach verification.

cases.problem_statement: Let $D,E$ be the midpoints of $AB,AC$ in triangle $ABC$. Prove $DE\parallel BC$.

cases.problem_statement: Prove that the diagonals $AC$ and $BD$ of a rectangle $ABCD$ have equal lengths.
